task: U4 sparse-MoE final-layer independent replication (second model)

model.routing_convention: softmax over all 64 logits, then top-8 of the probabilities, no renormalisation (actual model convention)

selection.cross_split_dedup: h_text = SHA256(UTF8(text)); any h_text occurring in BOTH splits disqualifies every row carrying it (both copies removed)
selection.order: lexicographic ascending on the hex k_row
selection.take: first 16 eligible rows, first 128 token ids

loss.form: manual next-token cross-entropy, L = (1/127) * sum_{r=0}^{126} CE(f_r, x_{r+1})

response.normalised_radius_definition: epsilon = rho * Theta with Theta = sqrt(sum_i ||theta_{15,i}||^2)
response.probe: D_probe_ts(rho) = [L_t(theta + eps d_s) - L_t(theta - eps d_s)] / (2 eps)

route_estimator.definition: T^(pi)_ts = sum_j <g^(pi)_{j,t}, g^(pi)_{j,s}>, g^(pi)_{j,d} = E_d[a_{pi^{-1}(j)} J_j^T d]

bootstrap.scheme: nonparametric over the 16 frozen permutation matrices

replication_equality_rules_pre_registere.tier1: |reference - replica| <= 1.0 * (2 * sigma_bank) AND identical qualitative gate labels
replication_equality_rules_pre_registere.tier2: |reference - replica| <= 2.0 * (2 * sigma_bank) AND identical qualitative gate labels
replication_equality_rules_pre_registere.sigma_bank: pooled permutation-estimator / Monte-Carlo dispersion measured with my own bootstrap (half-width of the 95% interval divided by 1.96); if an independent sigma_bank cannot be defined for a quantity, the fallback is |gap| / reference_CI_half_width <= 1.0 -> PASS
replication_equality_rules_pre_registere.note: declared BEFORE unblinding; may not be relaxed afterwards

uncertain_or_undocumented_details.instrumented_adapter: protocol names model.layers.15.mlp but not the call signature; resolved by the mandatory native-vs-instrumented reconstruction gate (<1e-6), which is an implementation control, not a taste choice
uncertain_or_undocumented_details.E_d_normalisation: 1/2032 per distribution; cross-checked by the cached-vs-direct identity-label gate
uncertain_or_undocumented_details.permutation_index_convention: implemented exactly as written (kernel slot j times weight label pi^{-1}(j)); the expectation T_route is invariant under the two possible label/slot conventions
uncertain_or_undocumented_details.adjoint_placement: m is the MoE block output added to the residual (Theory Note eq. 3.1); verified by the reconstruction gate
uncertain_or_undocumented_details.cross_split_dedup_direction: both copies of a cross-split duplicate h_text are removed; a secondary declared diagnostic records whether the alternative 'keep one copy' convention would change the selected sequences (it does not enter the node decision)
uncertain_or_undocumented_details.thread_count: 18 torch threads, fixed for determinism; recorded in environment.txt

secondary_declared_diagnostics_not_used_: cross-split dedup convention sensitivity of the selected sequences
softmax-at-precision variant (router logits in float32 vs model dtype) is NOT run: the installed block already softmaxes in float32 and the native path is the frozen object
torch thread-count sensitivity of one probe cell
